'''Cole Bozman Geez, Is This Deck Expensive''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Cole Bozman]]
* '''Published:''' May 1996 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room|Premiere-L-yavin4massassithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Geez, Is This Deck Expensive
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Prem Geez, Is This Deck Expensive Bozman.txt |Download]]
